The '''Garnib system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the blue star [[Garnib (star)/Legends|Garnib]], and four [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: [[Garnib]], [[Hultomo]], [[Mastala]] and [[Coomputu]].<ref name="PoG1" />
